title: Never-Worn and Declutter Candidates
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wardrobe:item
| eval days_owned=round((now()-acquired_epoch)/86400,0)
| where wears=0 AND days_owned>180
| sort - days_owned
description: Surfaces clothes you have owned for months but never worn, the prime candidates to donate or sell.
value: The never-worn pile is where wardrobe money goes to die; surfacing it makes decluttering easy and guilt-free.
implementation: Ingest wardrobe data into `index=personal`; flag long-owned unworn items.
visualization: Table of never-worn items by days owned.
grandmaExplanation: It finds clothes you have owned for ages but never worn, perfect to donate or sell.
